```python
def tri(n):
    tribonacci = [0, 0, 3]
    if n <= 2:
        return tribonacci[:n+1]

    for i in range(3, n+1):
        next_num = tribonacci[i-1] + tribonacci[i-2] + tribonacci[i-3]
        tribonacci.append(next_num)

    return tribonacci
```
